rules.title: Relocation assistance for owner move-in evictions (2026 inflation adjustment)
rules.requirement: If your landlord evicts you for an owner move-in, they must pay you relocation assistance. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.

coverage.summary: Tenants evicted for owner move-in under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance. The document does not describe which units are covered.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance (relocation assistance, owner move-in)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.

rules.title: Relocation assistance for Ellis Act evictions (2026 inflation adjustment)
rules.requirement: If your landlord evicts you to take the property off the rental market under the Ellis Act, they must pay you relocation assistance. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.

coverage.summary: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental market, under Berkeley's Ellis Implementation Ordinance. The document does not describe which units are covered.

rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.

notes: This is a Rent Board news item announcing the 2026 inflation adjustment (1.5% CPI) to the relocation payments, approved October 16, 2025. The document gives no municipal code section numbers, so each citation names the ordinance. The dollar amounts are split across lines in the source, so each quoted_span uses the sentence stating the obligation.
